24/7 Automatic Maintenance

Cleans Hard Disks, Browsers & More

Creates more memory for a faster PC

A first look
Every time you use your PC, the mountain of waste increases - How much is on your PC?
Thanks to the intelligent analysis, no data waste remains undiscovered. Simply start WashAndGo with a mouse click.
WashAndGo makes your PC as powerful as on the first day
You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs. This is exactly what happens when you use your computer. Already at the start, data rubbish is created and after a short time of using the PC, the rubbish mountain has grown to an enormous size. All the duplicate files, outdated apps, temporary system files and much more not only lead to a cluttered PC, but also considerably impair the speed and performance of your computer. With WashAndGo you can clean up properly and make your PC as powerful as on the first day.
WashAndGo optimises and speeds up your PC at the click of a mouse
WashAndGo is not only efficient and fast, but also particularly easy to use. At the click of a mouse, WashAndGo analyses your PC and finds any accumulation of junk data. After you have decided whether the cleaning should be fast or intensive and whether you want to create a backup for the sake of safety, you can enjoy a faster and tidier PC after just a few seconds. Of course, you can also have the cleaning carried out automatically - at every PC start, monthly, weekly or daily - just as you like.
Quality for over 20 years makes WashAndGo the test winner
For over 20 years, our experience has ensured that WashAndGo is one of the best in its field. Well-known technology magazines such as ComputerBild regularly put WashAndGo under the microscope and pit it against the competition. It turns out that WashAndGo is not only faster, but also more efficient than many other products. WashAndGo makes the difference - removes all the junk data on your computer quickly, safely and guaranteed and ensures a faster and tidier PC.
